s0.speaker: narrator
s0.text: The sacred light poured into the cracks of the mask until there was nothing left to crack.

s1.speaker: monk
s1.text: ...It's so bright. I had forgotten... it was warm.

s2.speaker: narrator
s2.text: The three stolen lights slipped free and fled home - to a shore, a city, a metro of a thousand dots.

s3.speaker: narrator
s3.text: And for the first time in eighteen winters, the samurai stood up.
